newsitem.title: TURKEY: SOCCER-RECORD TURKISH TRANSFER FEE FOR YALCIN.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-RECORD TURKISH TRANSFER FEE FOR YALCIN.

text.p: Sergen Yalcin became the most expensive player in Turkish soccer history when he signed for Istanbulspor from city rivals Besiktas this week for a record 1,150 billion lira ($7,960,000), Turkish media said on Friday.
Yalcin, Turkey international playmaker, was involved in a prolonged public wrangle with his former club Besiktas after demanding a payment of 400 billion lira ($2.8 million) to stay with the team.
When Besiktas refused to pay, the midfielder announced his decision to join Istanbulspor. Media reports said it would earn him 500 billion lira ($3.5 million).
"It wasn't easy for me to make this decision. The attitude of my club did not satisfy me. Now I'm an Istanbulspor man," Yalcin said.
Istanbulspor finished sixth in the Turkish league last season and have yet to win a major trophy since the club was formed in 1926.
